messages:
maya: Hey team — opened a PR to add a small 'Playground Cookbook' (kotlin interactive example + a short note about an auth header caching caveat we hit in staging). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/842 . Can @sam @leo take a quick pass? Low-risk docs change but used in the onboarding template so would like another set of eyes. :pray:

devex-bot: CI: PR checks passed · preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/playground-cookbook · lint: ok · link-check: warning (one external URL timed out) :eyes:

sam: I'll take a look in ~30m. Quick question — the Kotlin example uses streaming; is that intentional for the playground flow? small snippet looks like `client.stream(...)`. If so, add a note about handling partial responses / backpressure.

maya: Yep it's streaming on purpose to demo the client stream hooks + `onPartialToken` callback. I added a short paragraph about concurrency/backpressure and a minimal `curl` token-rotation snippet showing how to re-request with a fresh Authorization header.

leo: Left a tiny nit under "Auth caveats": the phrase "token refresh will not be visible to cached connections" is slightly unclear. Suggest: "token refreshes require reopening the connection; cached TLS sessions may continue using old headers" — or similar. Also added a suggestion to clarify the behavior for our hosted API vs Dedicated.

maya: pushed a follow-up commit (3f9a7d2) to reword the paragraph and added a short paragraph clarifying Hosted vs Dedicated behavior. Ran the docs linter locally and fixed minor markdown lint failures.

adele: Since this lands in the onboarding template, do we want a second reviewer for copy? It touches phrasing around auth which we get questions on. If not, I can approve once oliver checks the rendered preview.

oliver: I can sanity-check the rendered markdown and the screenshots later tonight and confirm accessibility bits. Will ping here when done.

sam: Found a tiny syntax issue in the Kotlin sample — missing `import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collect` which causes the sample to fail in the playground harness. Proposed change: add `import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collect` at top.

maya: Thanks — fixed and force-pushed (commit 7b2c1a4). Also updated the sample to use `collectLatest` and added a brief comment about coroutine scope.

devex-bot: Deploy preview updated: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/playground-cookbook (checks: lint ✅ · link-check: flaky external resource warning — retry queued) · accessibility: basic checks passed.

maya: Plan: merge tomorrow 09:30 PT after oliver confirms rendering, unless anyone objects. Will backport the small auth note to the older onboarding docset if needed. Thanks for the quick reviews! :tada:

oliver: Looked through the preview — markdown renders fine, screenshots align, accessibility spot-check ok. Approving from my side. :thumbsup:

adele: +1 from me as well.

maya: Great — merging tomorrow morning then. If the link-check flake still fails we can merge with an explicit exception and follow up with a PR to replace the flaky external URL. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
